name: artisanpack-ui/ecommerce
description: Ecommerce package for the ArtisanPack UI ecosystem.

suggest.stripe/stripe-php: Required for the built-in Stripe gateway and Stripe Radar fraud provider (^13.0 through ^22.0).
suggest.rebing/graphql-laravel: Required for the GraphQL API (^9.0 on Laravel 12, ^10.0 on Laravel 13).
suggest.orchestra/testbench: Required to run the satellite contract test kit (src/Testing/Contracts).
suggest.pestphp/pest: Required to run the satellite contract test kit (src/Testing/Contracts).
suggest.sentry/sentry-laravel: Attaches EcommerceException context to the Sentry scope when installed.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/cms-framework: Registers the ecommerce abilities as RBAC permissions and a shop-manager role when present. Admin nav comes from the admin satellites.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/visual-editor: The commerce blocks (product grid, single product, add to cart, cart, checkout, price, gallery) ship in the storefront satellites, such as artisanpack-ui/ecommerce-storefront-livewire, which register them when visual-editor is installed.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/media-library: Product images via media-library; falls back to a nullable image_url on ProductImage.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/forms: Enables product-inquiry and quote-request form field types and draft-order spawning from submissions.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/icons: Icon slot on product categories and kanban columns.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/accessibility: WCAG contrast checks for admin theme and cart/checkout color choices.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/livewire-ui-components: Required by the Livewire UI satellite packages that render engine data.
